1. (Currently amended) A composite stiffener, comprising: first, second and third members formed from laminated composite tape, the first and second members defining a web and flange member being joined to the flanges and extending generally transverse to the web, the first, second and third composite members intersecting to form a void; a filler disposed in and substantially filling the void; at least one layer of composite fabric on each of the members in the area of the filler, wherein the composite fabric is __applied as a separate layer distinct from the laminated composite tape of the members__; and, a layer of adhesive surrounding the filler and joining the filler to the composite fabric, wherein the adhesive is __a structural adhesive applied as a separate layer__.

2. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein the first and second members include radius areas between the web and each of the flanges, and the fabric layer covers the radius areas, __and wherein the composite fabric layer is applied separately from and overlying the laminated composite tape__.

3. (Original) [Claim 3 text not provided in original claims list]

4. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein the at least one layer of composite fabric includes graphite fibers held in an epoxy matrix, __and wherein the composite fabric layer is structurally distinct from the laminated composite tape members__.

5. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein the layer of adhesive and the at least one layer of composite fabric extend beyond the radius areas, __wherein the adhesive is applied as a separate structural adhesive layer distinct from any resin contained within the laminated composite tape or composite fabric__.

6. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein the at least one layer of composite fabric of the composite members are offset relative to each other, __and wherein the composite fabric layers are applied separately from the laminated composite tape members__.

7. (Currently amended) A composite stiffener, comprising: a pair of composite channels joined together, each of the channels including a web, flanges extending from the web, and radius areas between the web and each of the flanges; a base extending transverse to the web and joined to each of the flanges, the radius areas of the channels and the base forming at least one radius filler zone; a reinforcing member filling the radius filler zone; a layer of composite fabric covering the radius areas of the channels and the base, wherein the composite fabric is __applied as a separate layer distinct from the laminated composite tape of the channels and base__; and, a layer of adhesive surrounding the filler and joining the filler to the composite fabric layer, wherein the adhesive is __a structural adhesive applied as a separate layer__.

12. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 7, wherein the composite fabric layer includes three composite patches respectively on each of the channels and the base, __wherein each patch is applied separately from the laminated composite tape__.

13. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 7, wherein the layer of adhesive includes a sheet of structural adhesive wrapped around the filler, __wherein the structural adhesive sheet is a separate layer distinct from any resin in the laminated composite tape or composite fabric__.

14. (Original) [Claim 14 text not provided in original claims list]

15. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 7, __wherein the channels are formed from laminated composite tape and the base is formed from laminated composite tape, and wherein the composite fabric layer and structural adhesive layer are applied separately from the laminated composite tape__.

25. (Currently amended) A composite stiffener for aircraft applications, comprising: an I-section structure formed of laminated composite tape with a web and flanges on each end of the web, the structure including a cap and base including radius areas between the web and the flanges and between the cap and base, the cap being joined to the first set of the flanges and the base being joined to the second set of flanges, the cap and the base each intersecting the web in the radius areas to define a radius filler zone; a layer of composite fabric covering the radius areas of the I-section structure defining the radius filler zone, __wherein the composite fabric is applied as a separate layer distinct from the laminated composite tape__; a reinforcing filler in the radius filler zone; and a layer of structural adhesive surrounding and joining the filler to the composite fabric in the radius filler zone, __wherein the structural adhesive is applied as a separate layer distinct from any resin in the laminated composite tape or composite fabric__.
